displayName: Wayfair API - Product Prices, Sale and Was Price, Reviews, Delivery
description: Wayfair API for Wayfair product prices - keyword search and category listings with price, sale price, was price (Wayfair's strikethrough), price label, discount, per-item price, badge, rating, review count, stock and open-box price, sorted by price or customer rating and filtered by sale, closeout, open box, new arrivals, in stock, brand id, minimum rating, price range or any facet; one product in full by SKU or link with every option (size, color) and its option_id, the price and stock of one option, dimensions, specifications, the rating histogram, the review summary, the 5 reviews the page shows and a delivery estimate to a US ZIP or Canadian postal code; and the current sale events. wayfair.com, wayfair.ca (English and French), wayfair.co.uk and wayfair.ie, plus AllModern, Birch Lane, Joss & Main and Perigold. 4 endpoints, 1 credit each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
